profile.headline: Software Engineer at TransUnion
profile.summary:
I consider myself a computer wizard. I'm a programmer with excellent knowledge of front-end and back-end techniques, graphical designer who can bring designs to life and a very good animator (2D & 3D). I love structure and order and the quality of my works are second to none. I love fixing even the little things and making them picture perfect. I am a team player who performs better as the team leader. I am a good listener too, which makes team play easy, as the saying goes: 'two heads are better than one'​.

Visit my website www.toshenmthomas.tk to know more!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Cherry Hill, New Jersey, United States

positions.title: .NET Developer, Mobile App Developer & UI Designer
positions.description:
I worked as a .NET Developer, Android Developer, iOS Developer, UI / Graphics Designer at CobbleStone Systems Corp. in New Jersey.  I use the magic of HTML 5, CSS3, jQuery and javascript to create awesome front-end UI experiences to the fast, optimized, and well documented .NET C# back-end code, developed with User Interactions and easiness. Yes, I do both Front-end and Back-end dev. And that's just the Desktop end. 

In the Mobile end of things, I like developing native apps in both Android Studio (Android) and Swift (iOS). There too, I develop apps with User Interactions and easiness of usage with high priority. Working here is awesome as I get to do all the things I like to do! This company got its first official app made by me in both the Google Play Store and the Apple App Store.

positions.title: Graphics Designer
positions.description: During my time as a Graphics Designer, I created numerous posters and ads for one of the biggest technical fests in India - graVITas`16. My experience here made me go deep into graphical designing, and  taught me to create masterpieces that everyone would appreciate.

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
• Designed UI and UX for a mobile software application with the purpose of helping patients recovering from liver transplantation.
• Was a key integral team member in the deployment of mobile devices for a large-scale clinical trial.
• Created internal documentation for software development and deployment.
• Created UAT (user acceptance testing) documentation, to be used for prospective patients in the field.

positions.title: Volunteered Pharmacy Technician
positions.description:
Total Hours : 100
This was one of the coolest thing I've ever done - being a Pharmacy Technician! Here I got a chance to work in a big pharmacy, learned to mix and make medicines, worked with the cool robotic tech, dispensed medicines, and interacted and managed patients.

positions.title: Event Head - Inceptra 2K15
positions.locationName: Rajagiri College of Management & Applied Sciences, Kochi
positions.description: I was one of the 4 Event Heads for the first ever tech fest in our college! I had a chance to demonstrate my skills in being a good team leader as well as a good team player, managing over 50 team members; started my way into video editing and animation for the fest videos (one of the video placed below), and made our club, the RCMAS Computer Club,  the best and active club in the college!

projects.title: Mess Mate
projects.description: Mess Mate is a helpful application for the students staying in the hostels, inside the campus. It is an irksome job for the students when it comes to checking out the food available for the day and calculating the monthly expenditure on their food. This application makes it easier for the students to understand the daily mess menu and therefore, help them to overcome this tedious activity of managing their budget.

projects.title: TMTM EPIC
projects.description: The TMTM Entertainment Portal Inside Campus (EPIC) will be a next gen intranet based entertainment portal where students can share and view various entertaining and informative videos, audios, pictures, etc from the online database. It is a simple to use; responsive website where users can log in either from their laptops or from their mobile phones.

organizations.name: Computer Club RCMAS
organizations.description:
During my time as the Head of Computer Club at RCMAS, we've conducted a lot of competitions for the students of RCMAS to excel in various computing fields. Some of them are 
-> A Poster to Santa ( Poster Designing Competition using Photoshop)
-> Racing Rivals : Most Wanted ( LAN Gaming Competition)
-> Brazuka Fest
